items.title: Jeff Riddick Interview, 1983-07-14
items.q: He was the original banjo player in that band.

ctx.x: One instrument? Fliver played guitar and banjo. Freddie, whatever his name, I can't remember his name, saved my life. He was the original banjo player in that band. Then Fliver Ford took his place.
Well I'm getting confused on who played what instrument. Is it J.B.
